patch_description: This crossover replaces the over-parameterized pair-specific rotations with globally shared RY/RZ layers, reducing the model from 80 to 26 parameters and improving regularization under symmetric mean-Z readout. It retains complete-graph CZ entanglement to align the ansatz with all 28 pairwise feature channels, while adding one shared trainable central CRZ interaction for adaptive phase correction. A final shared RY layer converts the accumulated feature-dependent phases into the measured Z basis. This combines the strongest parameter efficiency and generalization properties of the prior symmetric designs with a small controlled-rotation enhancement that previously achieved the best validation accuracy and loss.
